sources.title: City of Bothell - Permit Center
sources.supports: All permit applications online only through MyBuildingPermit; permit status lookup; Permit Center phone 425-806-6400 and permits@bothellwa.gov; 'Electrical permits are obtained through Labor and Industries.'

sources.title: City of Bothell - FAQ: When is a permit necessary?
sources.supports: New construction, remodels or repairs to existing structures or systems generally require a permit; replacing a water heater or furnace may require one; homeowner responsible for all required inspections incl. final; inspection requests by 4pm previous business day; insurance and disclosure reasons for permits.

sources.title: City of Bothell - Residential Plumbing and/or Mechanical Alterations/Additions/Replacement form
sources.supports: Line items for compressors, air conditioners and heat pumps, heating equipment incl. ductwork; pad-mounted heat pumps/AC not in front yard setback, at least three feet from adjacent property line or structure incl. fences, screened from public right-of-way; screening removable or 3 ft away. (Fee amounts not used.)

sources.title: Washington L&I - City Electrical Permits & Inspections
sources.supports: List of cities issuing their own electrical permits (Bellevue, Kirkland, Lynnwood, Mountlake Terrace, Seattle, etc.; Bothell not listed); DOR address lookup to confirm city vs county jurisdiction.

sources.title: Washington L&I - Purchase Permits & Request Inspections
sources.supports: Homeowners should only buy an electrical permit for their own work; L&I strongly encourages hiring an electrical contractor; hired electrical contractor must purchase the permit for their work.

sources.title: EPA - Section 608 Technician Certification
sources.supports: Technicians who maintain, service, repair, or dispose of equipment that could release ozone-depleting refrigerants must be certified.

sources.title: EPA - Section 608 of the Clean Air Act
sources.supports: National Recycling and Emission Reduction Program; prohibits intentionally venting refrigerants.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit
sources.supports: Online permit application portal used by Bothell.

sources.title: Washington L&I Verify
sources.supports: Verify contractor registration, license, and bond.
